lump_sum_tax_federal_minimum_2026.note: Federal minimum taxable base for the lump-sum taxation (forfait fiscal) residence route, up from CHF 434,700 in 2025. HIGH-RISK STALE FIGURE: many secondary sites republish CHF 434,700 (the 2025 value) as current, or cite CHF 421,700/429,700/451,200, none of which are correct for 2026. Cantons may set higher minimums; 5 of 26 cantons (Zürich, Schaffhausen, Appenzell Ausserrhoden, Basel-Landschaft, Basel-Stadt) have abolished this regime entirely.

third_country_quota_b_permits_2026.note: Annual federal quota for third-country national B (residence) work permits, frozen unchanged from 2025. Confirmed 19 November 2025.

third_country_quota_l_permits_2026.note: Annual federal quota for third-country national L (short-term) work permits, frozen unchanged from 2025.
